title: Structure nodes stick to their Map sheet when moved
description:
Structure nodes in Map Builder were drawn on the world SVG, so dragging a PDF sheet left the markers behind. They are now drawn inside each page’s local overlay (same as highlights), so markers ride with the sheet. Page fractions (nrx/nry) stay the anchor — PDF Viewer scroll/layout does not float nodes off the page.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, place a node, then drag that sheet in Map Builder — the marker should stay on the same spot on the drawing.
changeLog: Draw Map structure nodes in page-local SVG so they move with the sheet.
Remove structure markers from the world SVG (no more left-behind nodes).
Keep Viewer nodes page-anchored; scroll does not detach them from the sheet.
